GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2010-10-19T19:53:46Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is there a specific reason why filter/map/reject/etc don't return new Collections?
Description: I would expect those methods to return new Collections, because generally when you map over something, you return a new type of that same something. For example, I would expect `stillAlive` to be a collection:

```
var coll = new MyCollection([foo, bar, baz, quux]);
var stillAlive = coll.filter(function (o) { return o.get("HP") > 0; });
```

Is this by design?

Aside: I really wish Github would make mailing lists or forums for projects, so that these types of issues wouldn't clog up the issues page...
